key.name: active
key.summary: Keep the screen awake while it is actively changing
key.description: When enabled, the guard holds an idle + suspend inhibitor while the compositor keeps producing frames, so video, animations and remote desktop sessions do not let the machine blank or auto-suspend.

key.name: minimum-fps
key.summary: Frames per second considered “the screen is changing”
key.description: The average painted frames per second (over a few seconds) above which the screen is treated as active. Reading a static page (blinking caret, panel clock) stays below this; video and animations go far above it.

key.name: grace-seconds
key.summary: Seconds to keep inhibiting after the last change
key.description: How long the guard keeps the session awake after the screen stops changing. Prevents flickering between active and idle at scene cuts.

key.name: debug
key.summary: Log frame rate and inhibitor transitions
key.description: Verbose logging to the journal, for troubleshooting.
